result.description: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, wikis, databases and project/task management.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 for public/OAuth integrations (per-user tokens, page picker); static internal connection token and user-scoped personal access token (PAT), both sent as Authorization: Bearer. Notion-Version header required.
result.access_detail: Create connections in the Developer portal, free. Public OAuth integrations usable in any workspace without review; security review needed only for optional Marketplace listing. Internal connection creation needs workspace owner; a free personal workspace works. PAT default on Free plan is workspace owners only. Enterprise-only: SCIM/Admin APIs.
result.api_notes: REST at https://api.notion.com, versioned via Notion-Version (2026-03-11). ~200 reference pages: pages, databases/data sources, blocks, comments, users, search, file uploads, webhooks, views, plus Admin and SCIM (Enterprise). Official JS SDK; Postman collection.

evidence.quote: Authenticate Notion API requests with personal access tokens, internal connection tokens, or OAuth integration OAuth flows.
You can create and use a public connection without listing it.
A public integration is an OAuth integration that users can install in any Notion workspace.
Use a public integration so users in any workspace can authorize your app through OAuth.
